warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>, C1' — footing mark + column C1 standing on it. C1 is recorded once, in the S-02 structure-plan file (same 14 points), so it is not repeated here.
No footing at B1, B2, C3, C4, E1, E4: rows B and C carry footings only at B3/B4 and C1/C2, row E only at E2/E3 (the porch).
F2 caps (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-05) are drawn with the 0.90 side along x at all three positions (B3, C2, D3).
